summary: You have a consistent, competent profile across the board, sitting in the low-to-mid 70s in every competency. The most pressing focus is Data Structures and Algorithms, which is flagged as a persistent gap and is stable rather than improving across CSE1OOF and CSE2ALG. Object-Oriented Design and Project Management are developing and worth firming up, while your Technical Communication and Industry Standards work is already proficient and a solid base to build from. Every marker points to the same lever: clearer reasoning, tighter technical precision, and more complete testing or reflection.

priorities.evidence: This is a persistent gap at 72.6%, stable across CSE1OOF (72.8%) and CSE2ALG (72.8%). Your weakest performance was CSE2ALG:Central examination at 71.0%, below your CSE2ALG:Test result of 77.0% (your strongest DSA mark), showing the exam-style application of these SILOs is where marks slip.
priorities.actions: Re-read the CSE2ALG:Central examination feedback and redo the questions where you lost marks, this time writing out the algorithm/data-structure choice and justifying it against alternatives (CSE2ALG:SILO4). For CSE2ALG:SILO5, re-attempt the CSE2ALG:Assignment problems adding explicit performance measures and complete test cases. Compare your stronger CSE2ALG:Test approach with your exam approach to carry over what worked.

priorities.evidence: Developing at 72.7% in CSE1OOF. Your CSE1OOF:Central examination (72.0%) was your lowest OO mark, and markers on both it and CSE1OOF:Assignment (74.0%) noted a need for clearer reasoning and more complete testing or reflection.
priorities.actions: Revisit the CSE1OOF:Assignment feedback and rework your design write-up to explicitly show how objects combine data structure and behaviour (CSE1OOF:SILO1) and where you reused code to cut development time (CSE1OOF:SILO3). Re-do the CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration tasks for a real-life problem (CSE1OOF:SILO4) with a full test suite and a short reflection on each design decision.

priorities.evidence: Developing at 74.0% in CSE3CAP, evidenced by CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports (74.0%), where the marker asked for clearer reasoning and tighter links between decisions and implementation.
priorities.actions: Revisit the Sprint Project management reports feedback and rewrite one sprint report so each management decision (CSE3CAP:SILO1) is justified and traced to what actually happened in the implementation, adding evidence of how you tracked progress and adjusted.
